discovery.evidence: The 2026-07-28 server MUST implement server/discover; a client MAY call it before other requests or use it as a probe. The current SDK 1.x server has no implementation.

transportLifecycle.evidence: The current server is session/initialize based and has not implemented the 2026-07-28 per-request protocol and capability context.

resultType.evidence: Current tool descriptors expose inputSchema and outputSchema but do not declare the candidate resultType contract.

cacheMetadata.evidence: No candidate list response evidence covers ttlMs and cacheScope.

subscriptions.evidence: The current server has no subscriptions/listen implementation or lifecycle evidence.

extensions.evidence: GIS Engine claims no protocol extension; any future extension must be explicitly negotiated and tested.

oldClientBehavior.evidence: A 2026-07-28 client MUST treat a result from an earlier-protocol server that omits resultType as complete. This policy does not change the current runtime default.
